strengths.value: Open release of pre-trained and post-trained 8B, 70B, and 405B models with 128K context, enabling community research and reproducibility.

ev.quote: We are publicly releasing all three Llama 3 models under an updated version of the Llama 3 Community License

strengths.value: Flagship 405B model performs on par with leading models like GPT-4 across many tasks.

ev.quote: our flagship model performs on par with leading language models such as GPT-4 (OpenAI, 2023a) across a variety of tasks

strengths.value: Reports 95% confidence intervals on benchmark scores, improving statistical rigor.

ev.quote: we report on this variance via 95% confidence intervals (CIs), assuming that benchmark scores are Gaussian distributed.

strengths.value: Open release of FP8 inference kernels and quantized Llama Guard 3 supports efficient deployment.

ev.quote: We have publicly released our implementation of FP8 quantization.

weaknesses.value: Standard benchmarks do not adequately reflect FP8 quantization effects; the model can produce corrupted responses without scaling-factor upper bound.

ev.quote: we find that such benchmarks do not adequately reflect the effects of FP8 quantization. When scaling factors are not upper bounded, the model occasionally produces corrupted responses

weaknesses.value: FP8 quantization quality is sensitive; first and last Transformer layers and attention layers are kept in higher precision.

ev.quote: We do not quantize parameters in the self-attention layers of the model. ... we do not perform quantization in the first and last Transformer layers.

weaknesses.value: Llama 3 may still generate harmful content for non-English languages and under skilled adversarial prompting.

ev.quote: Llama 3 may still generate harmful content due to training on various datasets, particularly for languages beyond English and when prompt engineered by skilled adversarial red teamers.

weaknesses.value: Adding system safeguards trades higher refusal rates of benign prompts for lower violation rates.

ev.quote: adding system safeguards (and any safety mitigations in general) comes at the cost of increased refusals to benign prompts.

limitations.value: FP8 quantization is applied only to feedforward weights and activations on H100 GPUs; attention layers and first/last layers stay in higher precision.

ev.quote: we quantize most parameters and activations in the feedforward network layers in the model ... We do not quantize parameters in the self-attention layers

limitations.value: Quantization is studied only at FP8 (and int8 for Llama Guard); no sub-8-bit weight or activation quantization is reported for the main models.

ev.quote: We investigate two main techniques to make inference with the Llama 3 405B model efficient: (1) pipeline parallelism and (2) FP8 quantization.

limitations.value: Inference is measured on data-centre H100 GPUs; deployment on mobile or edge hardware is not evaluated.

ev.quote: We perform experiments leveraging the native FP8 support of H100 GPUs to perform low-precision inference.

limitations.value: Multimodal extensions for image, video and speech are still under development and not released.

ev.quote: The resulting models are not yet being broadly released as they are still under development.

future_work_stated.value: Continue to identify safety risks and develop mitigation methods, encouraging community contributions to the open-source safety suite.
